items.title: Willie Hightower Interview, 1958-06-03
items.q: We had to leave Dominic there. We left Dominic there until we got to Long Beach. They kept him in the hospital two weeks. I can't think of that band leader's name... Then I had the pleasure of shaking hands with the man that made C.G. Conn's first Wonderhorn. That was, uh, the man had the band in Lo

ctx.x: Scissors Grinder. Yeah. Sure, yeah, I have that number. What is that? The Scissors Grinder. You know, the scissors. Scissors! That was the number. That was the number. That was the number.

That was the number. And he got a little more ingenious because they told him he'd have to get out of it. But he died before he ever played anymore. And it wouldn't change his style for nothing. Well, I knew back in all the times that I was coming along that the time was changing. Well, up until 1918 they hadn't got a change yet. See, because still the white musicians were still criticizing the Negro musicians were playing music because they said that it never would last nowhere. That putting, they say, a beer…
